blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday stood by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s previous pronouncement that the United States-led Pax Silica initiative will not include plans to build data centers in the Philippines. “According to the President, he has repeatedly stated that there will be no data center for Pax Silica,” Palace press officer Claire Castro said in Filipino during a regular briefing. She reiterated the clarification despite a House bill that includes provision for the establishment and operation of data centers.
